The lyrics used here are the original Rigvedic mantras based on which the series Bharat Ek Khoj had created their music.
RV 1.7
Indramid gathino brihad
• indram id gāthino bṛhad*
Indra — the singers (loudly) [sing of]
Indramarkebhirarkin
• indram arkebhir arkiṇaḥ*
Indra, the chanters, with their chants
